pattern_id: Membership Change Rejection Under Concurrent Operations
description: During concurrent membership changes, Raft implementations may reject subsequent configuration changes when a previous change is still pending. This is expected behavior that prevents race conditions and maintains cluster consistency. Nodes correctly log "possible unapplied conf change" messages when rejecting concurrent changes.
trigger_condition: Multiple configuration changes proposed in rapid succession before previous changes are fully applied
test_template: Create a cluster with learners, propose multiple concurrent membership changes (learner promotions, node additions), verify all nodes maintain consistent views, check that rejected changes are properly logged
